DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA cor. Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilq.gov.ph DILG OPINION No. 112 s. 2021 September 10, 2021 DIRECTOR JOSEPHINE CABRIDO-LEYSA Regional Director, DILG-Region XII Prime Regional Govemment Center Carpenter Hill, Koronadal City Dear Regional Director Cabrido-Leysa: This has reference to the following documents received by the Central Office on various dates relative to the appointment controversy in Sangguniang Panlungsod Member position in Tacurong City, Province of Sultan Kudarat: 1. A copy of the Letter of Sultan Kudarat Provincial Governor Suharto Mangudadatu regarding the appointment of Ms. Lina Montilla as Sangguniang Panlungsod Member of the City of Tacurong with DMS No. 2021-08-25-096; and 2. A copy of the reply letter of Ms. Lina Montilla, Nacionalista Nominee to Fill- In the Vacancy in the Sangguniang Panlungsod of Tacurong due to the vacancy created by reason of death of Charito Collado with DMS No. 2021- 08-27-068 and OUSLG-2021-08-31-001. As culled from the documents and attachments received by the Central Office, hereunder are the factual antecedents: 1. On 24 March 2018, Charito L. Collado completed her Basic Membership Seminar with the Partido Demokratiko Pilipino-Lakas ng Bayan. A certificate of membership was accordingly issued to this effect [Annex A]; 2. On 10 October 2019, Charito L. Collado, a member of PDP Laban was nominated by the Nacionalista Party as its Guest Candidate for Member, Sangguniang Panlungsod, Tacurong City, Sultan Kudarat in the 2019 National and Local Elections. A Certificate of Nomination and Acceptance was issued to this effect [Annex B]; 3. After election, Charito L. Collado was proclaimed among the winners for the position of Sangguniang Panlungsod Member. A certificate of Canvass and Proclamation [Annex C] and Oath of Office were issued to this effect [Annex DI; Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

4. Charito Collado died on 20 August 2019 due to acute respiratory failure. On 07 October 2019, the Nacionalista Party nominated Lina Montillas as Member of the Sangguniang Panlungsod, Tacurong City, replacing Charito L. Collado. A certificate of Nomination was issued to this effect [ANNEX E]; 5. Upon knowledge of such nomination, Geraldine L. Collado, daughter of Charito L. Collado and a member of PDP-Laban, sent her protest letter to Governor Mangudadatu dated 08 December 2019 [ANNEX F] with a follow- through letter which is undated; 6. In a letter dated IO February 2021 signed by the undersigned [ANNEX G], the Department asked Governor Mangudadatu's justification in withholding Ms. Montilla's appointment to the position left by Charito Collado; 7. On 22 March 2021, Governor Mangudadatu informed the Department through a letter on his exercise of discretion 'to deny by inaction" the appointment of Ms. Montilla [ANNEX H], a supplemental letter was likewise furnished to the Department dated 25 March 2021 [ANNEX II; 8. On 09 August 2021, the Department issued a letter signed by Secretary Eduardo M. Afio addressed to Governor Mangudadatu [ANNEX J], pertinent portion of which reads: "In as much as the documents submitted to support the appointment of Miss Montilla appears to be in order, it becomes ministerial on your part to issue the appointment of Ms. Montilla to fill-in the vacancy caused by the death of SPM Collado to maintain the party representation in the Sanggunian in accordance with the will of the electorate." IO.PDP-LABAN and Geraldine L. Collado filed on 13 August 2021 a Petition for Declaratory relief with Prayer for Issuance of Temporary Restraining Order and Preliminary Prohibitory Injunction before the Regional Trial Court Branch 20 in Tacurong City [ANNEX K], asking the following reliefs: "WHEREFORE, premises considered, it is respectfully prayed that after trial, judgment be rendered by this Honorable Court: 1. Upon the filing of the petition, a Temporary Restraining Order be issued ordering the respondent its agents, representatives and persons acting in its behalf to cease and desist from issuing an appointment to Lina O. Montilla. 2. After due notice and hearing, a writ of preliminary injunction be issued enjoining the public respondent its agents, representatives and persons acting in its behalf from issuing an appointment to Lina O. Montilla; Page 2 of 5

3. Thereafter, a Resolution be rendered. Giving due course to the petition; Issuing a Resolution declaring that the later Hon. Charito L. Collado was a bona fide member of the PDP-LABAN. Issuing a Resolution declaring that the PDP LABAN has a legitimate right to nominate a party member, Geraldine L. Collado as Member, Sangguniang Panlungsod, Tacurong City, Sultan Kudarat. Other reliefs just and equitable under the circumstances are also prayed for." 11. In a letter dated 19 August 2021 [ANNEX LI, Governor Mangudadatu wrote DILG-Sultan Kudarat Provincial Director Margarita Baynosa apprising the latter that the appointment of Ms. Montilla is held in abeyance pending outcome/resolution of the Petition for Declaratory Relief filed by PDP-Laban. We respectfully disagree with the position of Governor Mangudadatu. We reiterate the earlier position of the DILG Secretary that Ms. Montilla has already submitted the documents required to support her appointment to the position vacated due to the death of SP Member Charito Collado. Such being the case and pending the outcome of the Petition for Declaratory Relief filed by the PDP-LABAN, it is a ministerial duty on the part of Governor Mangudadatu to issue the appointment in favor of Ms. Montilla to fill-in the vacancy caused by the death of SPM Collado to maintain the party representation in Sanggunian in accordance with the will of the electorate, as what is also provided for by law. First, Section 45 (a) and (b) of the Local Government Code of 1991 are instructive, thus: "SECTION 45. Permanent Vacancies in the Sanggunian. (a) Permanent vacancies in the Sanggunian where automatic successions provided above do not apply shall be filled by appointment in the following manner: (1) The President, through the Executive Secretary, in the case of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan and the Sangguniang Panlungsod of highly urbanized cities and independent component cities; (2) The governor, in the case of the Sangguniang Panlungsod of component cities and the Sangguniang bayan; (3) The city or municipal Mayor, in the case of Sangguniang Barangay, upon recommendation of the Sangguniang Barangay concerned. (b) Except for the Sangguniang Barangay, only the nominee of the political party under which the Sanggunian member concerned had been elected and whose elevation to the position next higher in rank created the last vacancy in the Sanggunian shall be appointed in the manner hereinabove provided. Page 3 of 5

The appointee shall come from the same political party as that of the Sanggunian member who caused the vacancy and shall serve the unexpired term of the vacant office. In the appointment herein mentioned, a nomination and a certificate of membership of the appointee from the highest official of the political party concerned are conditions sine qua non, and any appointment without such nomination and certification shall be null and void ab initio and shall be a ground for administrative action against the official responsible therefor." (Emphasis Supplied) As could be gleaned from the foregoing, the law uses the word "shall' vis-å-vis the filling-up of the permanent vacancies. The word "shall" herein connotes a mandatory behest since failure to appoint the replacement to the permanent vacancy will result to the breaking off of the party affiliation as willed by the people in the electionl and accordingly, compromise the delivery of government services in Tacurong City. Further, as already mentioned, Ms. Montilla has already accomplished the documentary requirements stated in paragraph (b) of the aforequoted Section 45 of the LGC. If the appointing authority has doubts on the qualifications as well as the documents submitted by the appointee, his resort is not to hold in abeyance the appointment of the appointee but to file an appropriate action before the proper forum as what PDP-LABAN and Geraldine Collado did when they filed the Petition for Declaratory Relief now pending before the RTC. Only a positive relief therefrom (i.e. Temporary Restraining Order, Writ of Preliminary Injunction, or Decision on the issues raised) rendered by the Court would justify the appointing authority's non-appointment of the appointee. Second, there being a Petition for Declaratory Relief pending before the RTC, we shall not comment on the issue on whether Charity Collado is a bona fide member of PDP-LABAN or Nacionalista Party since this is the crux of the controversy therein. However, just to reinforce the view that Governor Mangudadatu needs to issue the appointment pending the outcome of the Petition for Declaratory Relief, it may be well to emphasize that jurisprudence is replete of cases, as in fact acknowledge by Governor Mangudadatu himself, that the political party which the candidate indicated in her Certificate of Candidacy and to which she was elected prevails over other claims to the contrary. The Certificate of Candidacy filed by Charito Collado categorically stated that she was "OFFICIALLY NOMINATED BY" the Nacionalista Party as she has in fact attached the Certificate of Nomination and Acceptance issued by the Nacionalista Patty. Finally, all premises considered, we are of the view that pending the outcome of the Petition for Declaratory Relief filed by PDP-LABAN and Geraldine Collado before RTC, Governor Mangudadatu is mandated, as it is ministerial duty upon him, to issue the appointment to Ms. Montilla of the Nacionalista Party. I Navarro vs. Court of Appeals, G.R. No. 141307, March 28, 2001. Page 4 of 5

This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. Please be guided accordingly. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: RINGAN Unde cretary for Local Government OUSLG/MLl/LLl-s-LRALLD/clp/OUSLG-anor Copy fumished: DIRECTOR MARGARITA H.
